title: 第十三章 天王候选人 T第十四章 小精灵学院
content_zh:
小明的拜师，林萧自然不能接受。他所欠缺的只不过是机遇而已，况且自己也没有什么能教他的，对于小精灵的了解林萧不敢说胜过小明。
自己的半吊子水准教徒弟只能害了别人，林萧现在理论十足，对战、策划经验不足，说得难听点就是纸上谈兵。
经过林萧的开导小明也没了拜师的心，开始收拾行李准备旅行，按林萧说的读万卷书，不如行万里路，很多东西是书本里学不到的，只能在各地旅行中慢慢体会了。
不过分别前，林萧还是为小明指了一条路。
“小明，如果你真心想拜师的话，可以去红莲岛找红莲道馆的馆主夏伯，夏伯可是天王级别的人物哦。能不能成功就看你自己的努力了，不过在找到夏伯之前你最好收服一两只火系小精灵，夏伯走的是火系专攻路线。”说完朝小明摆摆手，带着芽衣离开了。
“谢谢。”小明对着林萧的背影微微鞠躬感谢，随后背上背包准备出发，“走咯穿山鼠，这里离红莲岛可是很远呢，而且我还没有火系的小精灵，得提前准备才行。”
走出老远后，芽衣才疑惑问道：“小明这么诚心，为什么你不收下他呢？”
微微摇了摇头，林萧点了根烟吸了几口，轻声道：“道不同，我怕我会害了他。”
“什么意思？”林萧的解释让芽衣一头雾水。
“呵呵，”林萧微微一笑，“就像四天王，都有自己的道，而我的道走的是力量与碾压，以自我为中心，用绝对的实力碾压对手，这对小精灵的要求很高，实力不强一切都是空谈。”
“不可否认，我是想收下小明，但又不能收，现在你明白了吧？”
芽衣用小手杵着下巴，眨了眨可爱的大眼睛，“有点明白，但还是听不懂。。。。。”
芽衣吐了吐可爱的小舌头，“真搞不懂你，明明年纪不大，干嘛还一直说话装老成？不知道的人还以为你是个老头子呢。”
“我去！”什么叫装老头子？林萧满天黑线的看着芽衣。
芽衣摊开自己的小手，示意自己说的没错。
“算了，不和小女孩一般见识，就不和她计较了，赶路要紧，对，赶路。”
林萧不知道的是，他给小明推荐师傅，给小明推销，而神奇宝贝联盟总部，也有人在帮他推销。
联盟总部某个研究所内，四天王中的渡正朝自己的好友抱怨，“我说雪城，你也太不够意思了吧。当初一声不吭卸下天王职位，到总部做研究员，你倒舒服了，我和希巴就惨了，关东、成都两头跑，连休假日都没有。”
“呵呵，”大木雪城扶了下鼻梁上的眼镜，坏笑道：“这叫有先见之明，谁让你太贪心的，做关东的天王还不满足，还把成都的冠军拿下了，你这是自作自受。”仔细看的话，大木雪城和他儿子小茂有七分像，只是脸上多了一副眼镜，看起来更加沉稳，斯文。
渡对大木雪城的鄙视视而不见，转身亲热的搂着大木雪城的肩膀，笑道：“怎么？好友有难你不帮忙，那你还是兄弟吗？只要兄弟你重出江湖，一切的难题都解决啦。”

“去去去，离我远点。又想拉我下水，此事绝对不行。”
“真的不行？”
“不行。”
“没得商量？”
“没商量。”
“哎~”渡泄气的趴在桌子上，唉声道：“现在联盟青不接黄，要么太老，要么还小没有成长起来。我们关东和成都地区什么时候才能出现希罗娜那样的人物，现在开个会神奥地区的那些家伙一个个鼻孔朝天的，看了就不爽。”
大木雪城拍着渡的肩膀，安慰道：“那也是没有办法的事，不过你弟弟勇次就不错啊，都已经做了几年的橘子联盟最高训练家了，往上提一下应该能成为天王候选人。”
谁知渡的声音立马提高了八度！“那不争气的家伙，别给我提他，想起来我就火气冒，我当初说只要他的快龙达到天王级，我就捧他上去，可他死活不干，说是要以自己真正的实力坐上那个位子。”实际上天王也并不是要所有的小精灵都是天王级，只要有一只达到，其他有精英实力就可以。
“或许我可以给你提供一个人选哦。”
大木雪城摇摇手指说道：“怎么样，想知道吗？”
可接下来渡的话差点没把大木雪城气死。
“你不会是说你刚出发旅行的儿子吧？”渡上下打量大木雪城，那眼神简直就是：嘿！兄弟，想不到你也会利用关系抓权利。
“滚！！谁他娘的和你开玩笑，收起你那恶心的眼神，我怕我等会吃不下饭。我说的是林萧！不是小茂！”
“咳咳！！”渡尴尬的咳嗽两声，“我这不是开个玩笑吗？干嘛生气，至于吗？林萧不是你老爸的小助理吗，好像刚开始旅行吧，你确定不是想扶自己人上去？”
“渡！”大木雪城额头鼓起两个井字符号，黑着脸瞪着渡咆哮。
“混蛋！你把握大木雪城当成什么什么人了？我会做这种无聊事？就算我愿意，你以为能过的了我家老头子那一关？”
“老头子的快龙在他手里。”
大木雪城脱下身上的白大褂，转身朝门口走去，显然没有和渡谈下去的心情。
走到门口的大木雪城回头丢下一句，“除此之外，他还有一只班吉拉，老头子说了，那只班吉拉的实力不会逊色你的快龙和希罗娜的暴地龙，甚至更强。”
“还有，林萧的性子很倔，不要试图惹毛他，不然的话林萧绝对会跑到其它地区爬上去和你们对着干。言尽于此，你自己看着办吧，老头子不准我泄露林萧的信息。”

渡若有所思的望着大木雪城远去的背影，不知道在想什么。
大木雪城的话渡自然明白，意思就是：我什么都没有说，也什么都不知道，一切都是你自己调查出来的，老头子找麻烦也不别拉我下水。
良久，渡拿出移动电话拨号。
“喂，我到是渡。从现在开始对真新镇得林萧进行全力调查，不要干扰他的生活，暗中调查就行，调查结果直接向我汇报。”

content_en:
Lin Xiao naturally couldn't accept Xiao Ming's apprenticeship. All he lacked was opportunity, and besides, he had nothing to teach him. Lin Xiao couldn't say he knew elves better than Xiao Ming.
His half-baked teaching of disciples can only harm others. Lin Xiao is now full of theory and lacks experience in combat and planning. To put it bluntly, he is just talking on paper.
After Lin Xiao's enlightenment, Xiao Ming no longer wanted to become a disciple, so he started packing his luggage and preparing to travel. According to Lin Xiao's words, it is better to travel thousands of miles than to read thousands of books. Many things cannot be learned from books and can only be slowly understood while traveling around the world.
But before parting, Lin Xiao still pointed out a way for Xiao Ming.
"Xiao Ming, if you really want to become a disciple, you can go to Honglian Island to find Xia Bo, the master of the Red Lotus Gym. Xia Bo is a king-level figure. Whether you can succeed or not depends on your own efforts, but before you find Xia Bo, you'd better subdue one or two fire-type elves. Xia Bo takes the route of specializing in fire-type." After saying that, he waved to Xiao Ming and left with Mei Yi.
"Thank you." Xiao Ming bowed slightly to thank Lin Xiao's back, then put on his backpack and prepared to set off, "Come on, Mountain Rat, this place is far away from Red Lotus Island, and I don't have a fire elf yet, so I have to prepare in advance."
After walking far away, Yayi asked doubtfully: "Xiao Ming is so sincere, why don't you accept him?"
Shaking his head slightly, Lin Xiao lit a cigarette and took a few puffs, and said softly: "It's different. I'm afraid I will hurt him."
"What do you mean?" Lin Xiao's explanation made Mei Yi confused.
"Haha," Lin Xiao smiled slightly, "Just like the Four Heavenly Kings, they all have their own way, and my way is about strength and crushing. I am self-centered and use absolute strength to crush my opponents. This has high requirements for the elf. Without strong strength, everything is empty talk."
"It is undeniable that I want to accept Xiao Ming, but I can't. Do you understand now?"
Mei held her chin with her little hand and blinked her cute big eyes, "I kind of understand, but I still don't understand..."
Meiyi stuck out her cute little tongue, "I really don't understand you. You are obviously not very old, why do you keep talking and pretending to be mature? People who don't know better think you are an old man."
"I'll go!" What does it mean to act like an old man? Lin Xiao looked at Yayi with dark eyes.
Meiyi spread out her little hands to indicate that she was right.
"Forget it. If you don't know the little girl, I won't care about her. It's important to hurry up. Yes, hurry up."
What Lin Xiao didn't know was that he recommended a master to Xiao Ming and promoted Xiao Ming, and there were also people at the Pokémon Alliance headquarters helping him promote.
In a research institute at the alliance headquarters, Watari, one of the Four Heavenly Kings, complained to his friend, "Snow City, you are too boring. When you resigned from the position of king without saying a word and went to the headquarters to work as a researcher, you felt comfortable, but Shiba and I were miserable. We traveled between Kanto and Chengdu, and we didn't even have a day off."
"Haha," Damu Xuecheng adjusted the glasses on the bridge of his nose and said with a bad smile: "This is called foresight. Who made you too greedy? You are not satisfied with being the king of Guandong, but you also won the championship of Chengdu. You are bringing it upon yourself." If you look closely, Damu Xuecheng looks like his son Xiaomao, but with an extra pair of glasses on his face, he looks more calm and gentle.
Du turned a blind eye to Damu Xuecheng's contempt, turned around and hugged Damu Xuecheng's shoulders affectionately, and said with a smile: "What? If your friend is in trouble and you don't help, then are you still a brother? As long as you come back to the world, brother, all the problems will be solved."
"Go, go, stay away from me. If you want to drag me into the water again, this will never work."
"Really not?"
"No."
"No need to discuss?"
"No negotiation."
"Hey~" Du leaned on the table in frustration, and sighed: "Now the alliance is too young to pick up the yellow, either it is too old, or it is too young to grow up. IWhen will characters like Sirona appear in our Kanto and Chengdu regions? Now when we have a meeting with those guys in the Sinnoh region, they all have their nostrils turned upward, which makes them uncomfortable. "
Oki Yukiro patted Watari on the shoulder and comforted him: "There is nothing we can do about it, but your brother Yuci is pretty good. He has been the top trainer of the Orange Alliance for several years. If he gets promoted, he should be a candidate for the King of Heaven. "
Unexpectedly, Du's voice immediately rose an octave! "That unlucky guy, don't mention him to me. I get angry when I think about it. I said at the beginning that as long as his dragon reaches the king level, I will support him, but he refuses to do it, saying that he wants to sit on that position with his true strength. "In fact, the King of Heaven does not require all elves to be King-level. As long as one reaches it and the others have elite strength, it is enough.
"Perhaps I can provide you with a candidate. "
Omu Xuecheng shook his finger and said: "How is it, do you want to know? "
But what Du said next almost made Damu Xuecheng angry to death.
"You're not talking about your son who just started traveling, are you? " Du looked at Damu Xuecheng up and down, and his look was simply: Hey! Brother, I didn't expect that you would also use your connections to gain power.
"Get out! ! Who the hell is kidding you? Put away your disgusting eyes. I'm afraid I won't be able to eat later. I'm talking about Lin Xiao! Not Xiaomao! "
"Ahem! ! Du coughed twice in embarrassment, "Isn't this a joke?" Why are you angry, as for that? Isn't Lin Xiao your father's little assistant? It seems that he has just started traveling. Are you sure you don't want to help one of your own? "
"cross! "Damu Xuecheng raised two tic-tac-toe symbols on his forehead, glared at Du with a dark face and roared.
"Asshole! Who do you think Damu Xuecheng is? Would I do such a boring thing? Even if I am willing, do you think you can pass the test of my old man? "
“The old man’s Kuailong is in his hand. "
Omu Xuecheng took off his white coat, turned around and walked towards the door, obviously not in the mood to continue talking to Du.
Damu Xuecheng, who walked to the door, turned back and said, "In addition, he also has a Bangela. The old man said that the strength of that Bangela is not inferior to your Kuailosaurus and Sirona's Tyrannosaurus, or even stronger." "
"Also, Lin Xiao has a very stubborn temper. Don't try to provoke him, otherwise Lin Xiao will definitely go to other areas and climb up to fight you. That being said, you can make up your own mind. The old man will not allow me to reveal Lin Xiao’s information. "
Du looked thoughtfully at the retreating figure of Damu Xuecheng, not knowing what he was thinking.
Du naturally understands what Damu Xuecheng said, which means: I didn't say anything, and I don't know anything. You investigated everything by yourself. Don't drag me into trouble even if the old man is looking for trouble.
After a long time, Du took out his mobile phone and dialed.
"Hey, I'm here to cross over. From now on, we will conduct an all-out investigation on Zhenxin Zhende Lin Xiao. Don’t interfere with his life. Just investigate in secret. The investigation results will be reported directly to me. "
